summary: Mobile game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Doodle Jump
entries.definitive_edition: Current official iOS/Android app build, with device/app state documented

emulation.notes: Use native mobile device route where possible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official app on a calibrated mobile device

primary.why: Doodle Jump is defined by mobile tilt controls and a constantly updated app-store route. The current official iOS/Android app is the practical route, while older platform ports such as Kinect, DS, and 3DS are control/history variants.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current App Store or Google Play build. Record platform, app version, device, OS, touch/tilt settings, ads/IAP state, leaderboard/Game Center or Google Play state, theme/world selected, and whether older ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting a specific port.
secondary.why: The mobile app is the core route.

all_releases.fidelity: Current mobile app route on Android.

all_releases.platform: Xbox 360 Kinect / Nintendo DS / Nintendo 3DS / arcade

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Current mobile app content, ads/IAP, and leaderboard state differ from launch and from non-mobile ports.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record app version, device, OS, ads/IAP, leaderboard state, and control settings.
